subject: c-info
title: (R)C.INFO.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 247 (CMOA(II)-5). C-INFO (composite information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-DY (extended dynamics). From TH-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From EXT-DY: TR (transformation). From MT-INFO: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: INFO-DS (information dissemination), POL-CON (political consciousness) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from INFO-DS. From AFTD: ATTN (attraction), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
